commands.name: Unlimited health
commands.description: Prevents lethal hazards and drowning. Fatal falls can still respawn Milo.

commands.name: Unlimited jumps
commands.description: Press jump again in midair; the camera follows Milo. Hold the button to open the bubble normally.

commands.name: Movement speed
commands.description: Multiplies Milo’s movement speed while preserving normal jumping and collision.

commands.name: Freeze timer
commands.description: Freezes the current race time without stopping movement, gates or the countdown before the race.

commands.name: Unlimited gliding
commands.description: Keeps the unlocked bubble fuel full. Does not unlock additional bubbles.

commands.name: Level gliding
commands.description: Maintains altitude while the bubble is open. Release the glide button to descend normally.

commands.name: Pollen tracker
commands.description: Locates the nearest uncollected pollen or unopened pollen container in loaded areas.

commands.name: Tinykin tracker
commands.description: Locates the nearest uncollected tinykin egg in loaded areas.

commands.name: Mission tracker
commands.description: Locates pending mission interactions with a verified physical target in loaded areas.

commands.name: Collectible tracker
commands.description: Locates the nearest visible, uncollected special item in loaded areas.
